turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Our washing machine flooded the kitchen, so I need a new one fast.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get through all the options before you weigh in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a cheap top loader at the hardware store, they can deliver it tomorrow, but it's really loud.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then a front loader that's super quiet and saves water, but it's about twice the price and takes a week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And my neighbour is selling her two year old machine for almost nothing, though I'd have to collect it myself.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The neighbour's machine is a great deal if it's working well and you can borrow someone to help lift it. The quiet front loader is the best long term, it'll save on water bills. The top loader only wins if you really can't go a week without washing.
